meta.title: Hebrew Phrases and Expressions
meta.subtitle: 161 expressions · 113 everyday, 32 idioms, 16 proverbs · both directions
meta.desc: 161 Hebrew set phrases, idioms and proverbs, in three subdecks: 113 everyday phrases, 32 idioms and 16 proverbs. Both study directions come as two cards of one expression — Hebrew → English (see the Hebrew, recall the meaning) and English → Hebrew (see an English meaning, recall the Hebrew) — each with a schedule of its own. This is a companion to the five level decks, Hebrew A1 to C1, and not one of them: a level is a list of words, and an expression is a unit a list of words cannot see. Nothing here is taught by any of the five, so the two can be studied together without repeating an entry. The PHRASES are the expressions Wiktionary files as phrases or interjections and does not mark as idiomatic — mostly the everyday formulas of greeting, thanks and reaction (על פי, אני מצטער, מה קורה …). The IDIOMS are expressions whose meaning is not their words' (בארבע עיניים, בדם קר, האותיות הקטנות …), and the PROVERBS the sayings Wiktionary files as proverbs (אל תסתכל בקנקן אלא במה שיש בו, נכנס יין יצא סוד, אין עשן בלי אש …). Within each subdeck the expressions come in the order of how many of Tatoeba's Hebrew sentences contain them; 73 of the 161 are found there, and the rest follow in the order of how common their words are in film and television subtitles. Every expression is printed as Hebrew is normally written, without vowel points, with the pointed form and Wiktionary's romanisation beneath it. Real example sentences come with 73 of the 161 expressions, three apiece for 43, with the expression picked out in colour and a speaker beside the sentence and the headword. Sources. Expressions, meanings, pointing, romanisation and the idiom and proverb labels: English Wiktionary, via the kaikki.org extraction (CC BY-SA 4.0). Order: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), CC BY 2.0 FR, then a word list built from OpenSubtitles (hermitdave/FrequencyWords, CC BY-SA 4.0). Example sentences: Tatoeba, CC BY 2.0 FR.
